inj.note: Davis-Gauthier has been ruled out for Week 9 after missing all week of practice. The Colts are without the 29-year-old for the first time this season. He has accounted for 65 tackles (33 solo) and one pass breakup on 92 percent of the Colts' defensive snaps in eight games. CJ Allen and Austin Ajiake could see more playing time in Davis-Gauthier's place.
